genres.palette_text: Primary #202F3E (news navy); Secondary #456B83 (steel blue); 3rd #F1F2F0 (paper white); 4th #C45A4A (alert red, sparingly).
genres.fonts_text: HEADLINE: Libre Franklin (700) | BODY: IBM Plex Sans (400–600) | LOWER-THIRDS: IBM Plex Sans (500–600). Google Fonts.
genres.music: Restrained documentary bed, subtle pulse, minimal piano; no sensational stingers.
genres.sfx: Newsroom room tone, paper, soft alert tick, restrained transition.
genres.delivery: Credible, composed, empathetic, evidence-led.
genres.hook: Who/what/when clarity, key development, context question, verified update.
genres.rhythm: Medium; clear chaptering; show dates and source labels; avoid frantic cuts.
genres.notes: Distinguish reporting, opinion and allegation. Verify footage date/location and protect vulnerable sources.
genres.motion: Broadcast / Editorial Lower-Third & Quote Style · Verified source badges, highlighted quote cards, clean bar/line charts, location lower-thirds, date stamps.

genres.broll: Relevant memes or clips with rights awareness, expressive hands/body language, objects, reaction cutaways, context footage.
genres.motion_style: Meme / Cutout Collage + Expressive Kinetic Text
genres.elements: Cutout PNG props, hand-drawn reaction doodles, exaggerated punchline captions, meme/tweet cards.
genres.mechanics: Snappy Pop / Boil / Freeze-Frame: Zero-ease instant pops (1–2 frames) for comedic timing; rapid punch-in zoom on presenter's face; hand-drawn squiggles vibrate at 8fps.
genres.fonts_text: HEADLINE: Archivo Black (400) | BODY: DM Sans (400–600) | PUNCHLINE EMPHASIS: Archivo Black. Google Fonts.
genres.music: Upbeat funk, quirky plucks, light hip-hop, playful electronic groove.
genres.sfx: Pop, click, record scratch sparingly, short comedic sting, room tone.
genres.delivery: Playful, expressive, conversational; timing matters more than loudness.
genres.hook: Unexpected comparison, absurd observation, relatable question, punchline-first.
genres.rhythm: Fast timing with deliberate pause before punchline; jump cuts and reaction holds.
genres.notes: Do not overuse meme SFX. Respect clip rights and context; avoid misleading edits or targeted harassment.
genres.motion: Meme / Cutout Collage + Expressive Kinetic Text · Cutout PNG props, hand-drawn reaction doodles, exaggerated punchline captions, meme/tweet cards.

genres.broll: Property walkthrough, room details, exterior, neighborhood, floor plan, material close-ups, daylight changes.
genres.elements: Animated floor-plan lines, room dimension arrows, neighborhood map pins, before/after renovation wipes.
genres.mechanics: Architectural Line-Draw: Floor-plan walls and dimension arrows draw cleanly from corner to corner; callout tags anchor smoothly to room features during camera movement.
genres.fonts_text: HEADLINE: Manrope (700–800) | BODY: Lato (400–600) | PROPERTY / PRICE DATA: Lato (600–700). Google Fonts.
genres.music: Minimal premium ambient, soft piano, light modern groove.
genres.sfx: Door handle, footsteps, room tone, soft UI ticks, subtle whoosh.
genres.delivery: Confident, welcoming, informative; avoid overpromising.
genres.hook: One standout feature, layout reveal, location benefit, common buyer question.
genres.rhythm: Smooth measured camera movement; use match cuts between rooms; allow spatial orientation.
genres.notes: Label area units, location and listing status. Avoid deceptive wide-angle distortion and unsupported investment claims.
genres.motion: Architectural Blueprint + Clean 3D/2D Callout Style · Animated floor-plan lines, room dimension arrows, neighborhood map pins, before/after renovation wipes.

motion_guide.visual: Flat geometric shapes, crisp 1–2px strokes, subtle drop shadows, organized grid layouts, high legibility.
motion_guide.text: Smooth directional slide-in (15–20px) paired with opacity fade; clean line-by-line mask reveals; zero chaotic bounce.
motion_guide.elements: Bars and charts grow smoothly from baseline; icons scale gently (90%→100%); callout lines extend cleanly from anchor dots.
motion_guide.fps_easing: 30 or 60 fps | Smooth Cubic Ease-Out (no overshoot)
motion_guide.signature: Trim Paths, Odometer Number Counters, Subtle Drop Shadows, Masked Text Reveals.
motion_guide.niches: Finance, Healthcare, Education, Law & Civic Rights, Career & Workplace.

motion_guide.visual: Rounded cards, glassmorphism panels, custom cursors, toggles, notifications, keyboard shortcut keycaps.
motion_guide.text: Monospace or clean sans typing reveals; pill badges popping in; highlighted text marker sweeps across key phrases.
motion_guide.elements: Interactive cursor glides with click-ripple; UI panels expand with snappy spring; spotlight zoom boxes magnify active areas.
motion_guide.fps_easing: 60 fps | Snappy Spring or Quart Ease-Out (150–250ms)
motion_guide.signature: Cursor Click Ripples, Magnifier Zoom Loupes, Glassmorphism Blur, Keycap Press Scale (92%).
motion_guide.niches: Productivity & Tutorials, Science/Tech/AI, Investing, Business & Startups.

motion_guide.visual: Glowing wireframes, grid overlays, dark/indigo canvases, telemetry readouts, interconnected node networks.
motion_guide.text: Digital character scramble/decode reveal; fast vertical wipe with 1-frame flicker; blinking terminal cursors.
motion_guide.elements: Glowing data dots travel along vector paths; nodes pulse upon connection; 3D/2D wireframe grids rotate slowly.
motion_guide.fps_easing: 30 or 60 fps | Linear Data Flow + Fast Expo-Out Snaps
motion_guide.signature: Path Tracing (Trim Paths), Subtle Chromatic Aberration, Telemetry Counters, Grid Parallax.
motion_guide.niches: Science/Tech/AI, Crypto & Market Data, Fitness Biomechanics.

motion_guide.visual: Rough brush/pencil strokes, highlighter marker sweeps, notebook/cream paper grain, organic imperfect shapes.
motion_guide.text: Handwritten stroke reveals; highlighter bar sweeps behind keywords; subtle frame-by-frame edge wobble (boil).
motion_guide.elements: Sketch arrows draw organically toward subject; circles loop around key items; cards drift gently like floating paper.
motion_guide.signature: Turbulent Displace (Boil Effect), Posterize Time (12fps), Brush Stroke Reveal, Paper Grain Overlay.
motion_guide.niches: Self-Help, Psychology & Relationships, Parenting, Comedy & Commentary.

motion_guide.visual: Torn paper edges, cutout photos with white sticker borders, tape/stamp overlays, halftone print textures, 2.5D depth.
motion_guide.text: Cutout ransom/label strips slapping onto screen; typewriter stamps; slightly tilted angle drops (±3°).
motion_guide.elements: Stop-motion stepped entry; layered Z-space camera parallax separating foreground cutouts from background photos.
motion_guide.fps_easing: 8–12 fps | Stepped Stop-Motion + Tactile Overshoot Drop
motion_guide.signature: 2.5D Multi-Plane Camera, Halftone/Film Grain, Drop Shadow Depth, Page Peel / Fold Transitions.
motion_guide.niches: History & Biography, Travel & Culture, Nutrition & Food, Pop Culture.

motion_guide.visual: Full-screen oversized display fonts, high-contrast color blocks, minimal icons, rhythm- and voice-driven layout.
motion_guide.text: Word-by-word slams synced to vocal stress; rapid scale punches (135%→100%); split-word mask slides.
motion_guide.elements: Minimal background shapes pulse on beat; micro camera shake (4–6px decay) on heavy impact words; hard cuts.
motion_guide.signature: Impact Scale Punch, Micro Camera Shake, Motion Blur, Beat-Synced Hard Cuts.
motion_guide.niches: Motivation & Discipline, Strong 3-Second Hooks, Comedy Punchlines.

motion_guide.visual: Topographic maps, archival newspaper clippings, redacted documents, string connections, broadcast lower-thirds.
motion_guide.text: Yellow/amber highlighter sweeps across document text; crisp lower-third wipes; typewriter date/location stamps.
motion_guide.elements: Smooth camera pan/zoom across map coordinates; red route/connection lines draw between pins; slow tension push-in.
motion_guide.fps_easing: 24 or 30 fps | Controlled Ease-In-Out & Continuous Slow Creep
motion_guide.signature: 3D Map Camera Fly-Through, Redaction Bar Wipe, Vignette & Film Grain, Highlight Sweep.
motion_guide.niches: Geopolitics, True Crime & Mystery, News & Journalism, Real Estate.

palette_roles.example: Background panels, main title blocks, major graphic areas
palette_roles.accessibility: Text on it must have strong contrast
palette_roles.important: Not a rigid percentage; adapt to footage and brand.

palette_roles.example: Subheadings, chart series, secondary panels, labels
palette_roles.accessibility: Check contrast with both primary and neutral
palette_roles.important: Keep meaning consistent across the video.

palette_roles.example: Caption backing, negative space, cards, backgrounds
palette_roles.accessibility: Prefer high contrast for small text
palette_roles.important: Often off-white, cream, grey or pale neutral.

palette_roles.purpose: Attention, status or one key highlight
palette_roles.example: Key number, warning, selected step, CTA detail
palette_roles.accessibility: Never rely on color alone; add label/icon
palette_roles.important: Use sparingly so it retains meaning.
